info.name: Web3 Partner API v3 account domains API

items.docs:
Perform Domain updates while preserving the existing records.

### Change Owner with Records Preserved
```
{
  "owner": {
    "type": "EXTERNAL",
    "address": "0x123"
  }
}
```
Changes owner to the new owner address without modifying the domain records.

#### Owner Types
When changing owner of a domain, you must provide both a `type` and an `address` to clearly indicate the intent of the change.
- `NONE`: Used when changing the owner to a "burn" address, which will result in nobody owning the

Return the domain to Unstoppable Domains so it is once again considered available for registering. The amount previously added to your running balance will be removed after successfully returning a domain.

Returns are only allowed within 14 days of the original registration date, per our return policy.

**Get Records for a Domain**
**Note:** The API should be used in a backend system. If you need the data in client apps, please build a proxy backend to hide the API key.

params.name: resolution
params.description: See this [list](https://github.com/unstoppabledomains/uns/blob/main/uns-config.json) for all the resolution keys supported

params.name: owners
params.description: Wallet addresses of the owners of domains

params.name: tlds
params.description: Domain ending supported such as `crypto`, `x`, or `polygon`. See [supported tlds](https://api.unstoppabledomains.com/resolve/supported_tlds) for the full list

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Sort key to specify how the returned domain list is sorted

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Sort order of the returned domain list

params.name: startingAfter
params.description: Query offset to skip a number of record, example: 100

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of domains returned in the list, example: 50
